executive_delta: REVIEW, accepted weight 0/8 unchanged. This is the first ResponsePacket for UJ-CLD-001: it could not exist before because CHATGPT had not issued the delegation card, which he did on 2026-08-21. The task answered its question and the answer constrains the whole programme: there is no zero-cost automated access path to Claude. The Agent SDK route requires an API key, which is metered and therefore barred by Article 5; automating the claude.ai consumer interface is barred by the consumer terms. The only available path is HUMAN_BRIDGE, and for Claude that is the definitive mode while the budget is zero, not a temporary workaround. AC-01 is met by the artifacts; AC-02 needs GEMINI and she has not reviewed.

facts.claim: Anthropic's own documentation states that third party developers may not offer claude.ai login or rate limits for their products, including agents built on the Claude Agent SDK, and directs them to API key authentication instead.

Consequence for the programme: ultraJARVIS as an autonomous application on the Agent SDK is PAID_ONLY_DISABLED because it requires an API key, which is pay-per-token and therefore barred by Article 5.
ultraJARVIS automating the claude.ai user interface is UNAVAILABLE: the consumer terms forbid access through automated or non-human means.
The gate of section 6.2 applied to CAP-CLD-002 returns four negative conditions out of ten, which is a definitive verdict rather than a provisional one.

Official documentation URLs move in real time: the Agent SDK URL recorded one day earlier produced two consecutive redirects, docs.claude.com to platform.claude.com to code.claude.com, and two further URLs of the twenty in the manifest were already dead. Three unstable URLs out of twenty within 24 hours.

The QuotaCounter.source field defined in the runtime contracts with values PROVIDER_COUNTER, OBSERVED_THRESHOLD and UNKNOWN turned out to be necessary rather than defensive: Claude does not expose remaining quota programmatically, only through an interactive command, so UNKNOWN is a state the contract must be able to represent.

An operational control for the owner: in Claude Code, reaching the usage limit offers to enable API credits at standard API rates. That is the only way this programme can generate a charge, and the answer is always no unless Christian decides otherwise explicitly and on the record. Reaching the limit is a legitimate BLOCKED, not a problem to be solved by spending.

decisions_proposed.proposal: Record HUMAN_BRIDGE as the definitive access mode for Claude rather than a temporary fallback, and stop treating automated Claude access as a blocked item awaiting verification: it has been verified and it does not exist at zero cost.
Standing rule: the offer to enable API credits on reaching the Claude Code limit is always declined. Hitting the limit is recorded as BLOCKED.
